newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's population to hit 7.38 million by 2006.
newsitem.headline: HK's population to hit 7.38 million by 2006.

text.p: Hong Kong's population, now at 6.4 million, will hit 7.38 million by mid-2006 and 8.21 million by mid-2016, the government said in a statement on Monday.
The expected 1.3 percent annual rise was mainly due to new immigrants from China and emigrants who return.
"The number of people coming back for the last few years has been substantial. This trend is going to continue in 1997 and into 1998," commissioner Frederick Ho said.

Thousands of residents who emigrated to countries in the West, many of them motivated by concern over the handover of the British colony to China on July 1, have returned in recent years to Hong Kong where they say they can find better jobs.
The territory is also likely to see an ageing population, the statement said.
The median age of the population is projected to rise to 39 in 2006 and 41 in 2016, from 34 in 1996, it said.
